approved_iou.source: Closed-mask (3px) IoU of the approved Blender 4.2 export, measured 2026-11-03 by validate.py against the four TCN direction sprites.

review.note: Approved by the repo owner in batch 1 (2026-11-03).

notes: Quarter-tile prop (offsets.json: quarter-tile). Origin at the quadrant centre, z=0 at the base. Rotatable: in view 0 the muzzle points to -x (raised about 43 degrees) and the trail rests on the ground toward +x, matching sprites 0-3. sprite_y_nudge -1 with the fitted sprite_shift [0,-1]. Lathe barrel, beam carriage, lathe tyres with cut-out spoke discs. Round 2: barrel profile 25% longer (forward of the trunnions), barrel origin moved back over the carriage and the whole prop offset -0.1 sim on x to stay inside +/-0.25 BU; trail 0.8 sim shorter. Steel is palette 12/13/14 with 19 as the single highlight; wheels are real cut-outs (no fill), spokes 106-108. height_sim 15 is the measured GLB tip (15.2 sim).
triangle_justification: 320 tris (70 over the 250 prop soft cap): 10-sided barrel lathe with muzzle lip and bore, two 12-sided tyre lathes plus spoke discs and a 5-beam carriage; fewer sides facets the barrel and wheel outlines at 64 px.
